logic.entry: At completed barj, use the last range_days daily closes includingj. low=min(window),high=max(window);score=(close[j]-low)/(high-low), Decimal28. If high==low use score0.5. Score is0..1, unsmoothed; no intraday high/low or future prices. When flat, enter iff score>entry_fraction; equality remains cash.
logic.exit: When long, exit iff score<exit_fraction=0.2; equality and deadband preserve held state. No time stop, smoothing or same-decision re-entry; costed terminal liquidation at frozen OOS end.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

sources.scope: Primary range-location idea; conventional stochastic uses bar highs/lows and optional smoothing. Our close-extrema-only, unsmoothed0..1 score and generated trading rule are explicitly different, not a literal replication or profitability endorsement.
Official filter definitions; historical filters remain unavailable.
